description: This file defines an abstract base class 'JsonBackedValueObject' for implementing value objects that are backed by a JSON object. It provides methods to access properties stored within the JSON object, including support for getting properties with default values and retrieving all properties as a map. The class utilizes Jackson annotations for JSON serialization/deserialization and integrates with Vert.x's JsonObject.

classes.name: JsonBackedValueObject
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides a JSON-backed implementation of value objects, allowing for flexible property management and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getPropertiesAsMap
methods.description: Returns a map of all properties stored in the internal JSON object for serialization purposes.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name, with optional default value, cast to specified type.

methods.name: getProperty (static)
methods.description: Static method that retrieves a property value from a JSON object, casting it to the specified type, with optional default value.
